RIP_TC68.steps:
Configure RIP for the 28.1.1.0/24 network on the Router, redistribute static route.
2. On the Network>Routing page of the SonicWALL, select Advanced Routing in the Routing Mode drop-down. Click OK in the message.
3. Click the Configure RIP icon for X2 (DMZ) interface.
4. In the Interface X2 (DMZ) RIP Configuration window, select Send and Receive, Receive RIPv2, Send RIPv2.
5. Do not check the Split Horizon checkbox . Save.
6. Check the RIP packets on FW.
7. Use the command "show ip rip database" on the Cisco router.
RIP_TC68.title: Split Horizon is not used
RIP_TC68.result:
"Split horizon" is a scheme for avoiding problems caused by including routes in updates sent to the router from which they were learned.
in step 6, FW learned static routes from cisco router, in the RIP packets send from FW's interface X2, all routes learned from cisco router are included in the RIP update with metric 1.
in step 7, when Split Horizon is not enabled, in cisco router, duplicate routes will appear in rip database, one is via router , another is via FW's interface X2.

RIP_TC69.title: Split Horizon is used without Poisoned Reverse
RIP_TC69.result:
"Split horizon" is a scheme for avoiding problems caused by including routes in updates sent to the router from which they were learned.The "simple split
horizon" scheme omits routes learned from one neighbor in updates
sent to that neighbor. In step 6, in the RIP packets send from FW's interface X2, all routes learned from cisco router are not included in the RIP update message.

RIP_TC70.title: Split Horizon is used with Poisoned Reverse
RIP_TC70.result:
"Split horizon" is a scheme for avoiding problems caused by including routes in updates sent to the router from which they were learned."Split horizon with poisoned reverse" includes such routes in updates, but sets their metrics to infinity.
In step 6, in the RIP packets send from FW's interface X2, all routes learned from cisco router are included in the RIP update message but the metric is set as infinity =16.
